name: venetian-blinds
title: Venetian Blinds
description: The outgoing scene is cut into horizontal slats that turn edge-on one after another, like blinds opening onto the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .vnb-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A crisp, architectural scene change with a visible rhythm.
Office, real-estate, corporate or editorial pieces that want a tidy reveal.
avoidWhen: The scenes are very busy: the slat edges add visual noise.
You want a soft, organic change.
author: Remocn
